# Repository entry point

Read and follow [the working agreement](../AGENTS.md), then
[the README](../README.md), [project context](../context/project.md) and
[handoff](../context/handoff.md). Load the linked procedures for the active task.

Use the working agreement as the single source of behavioral rules. This file
does not grant permission to publish, install integrations or create credentials.
Its presence supplies a compatibility entry point; actual discovery/use must be
verified in the target assistant and environment.
